d:
The Election Commission of India has told the Supreme Court that its key decisions on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls were taken unanimously. But does that answer the questions raised by The Indian Express investigation?
In this episode, Sayoni Aiyar examines the ECI’s sworn affidavit and the internal records that raise questions about how decisions were taken, when Election Commissioners were informed, and whether statutory election officials were able to perform their duties.
